title: moi intake.log.jsonl entry
description: Schema for a single line of intake.log.jsonl: one dose or use event. The file is JSON Lines (https://jsonlines.org/) — one object of this shape per line, appended in chronological order.

at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp of the event, including a timezone offset (e.g. 2026-05-28T09:12:00+02:00 or ...Z).

action.description: What the event records: a dose was `taken` (consumed) or a quantity was `purchased`. Omitted defaults to `taken`.

dose.description: Free-form, e.g. '400mg', '1 tablet'; for a purchase, the quantity acquired.
